organization_note: Alibaba Group Holding Limited is a Cayman Islands holding company with an executive office in Hong Kong; the principal executive offices of its major businesses are in Hangzhou. Its Qwen team develops the models, publishes them under the Qwen organizations, and builds Qwen Code, and Alibaba Cloud operates Model Studio. The catalog names the developer Alibaba for most releases and Qwen for two, and names the Model Studio operator Alibaba Cloud, so all three names belong to this record.
